title: REQ-20261103-OPS001 — External fund statements: Southern Cross Industry Super ($96,400, $520k Death & TPD) & Harbourline Retail Super ($41,800) (Priya Natarajan)
content:
Summary of the two external super statements supplied with Priya Natarajan's application pack (online statements downloaded 31 Oct 2026). Used by Transfers & Rollovers to raise the SuperStream rollover requests and by Benefits & Eligibility for the insurance-loss check.

1. Southern Cross Industry Super — USI SCI0001AU. Member number 88213045. Industry fund accumulation account (default fund of a previous employer). Balance about $96,400 — the final rollover amount depends on unit prices on the day it is paid. Preservation: preserved $96,400; restricted non-preserved $0; unrestricted non-preserved $0. Tax components: tax-free $0; taxable (taxed element) $96,400. Insurance: Death & TPD cover, sum insured $520,000, premium about $6.10 a week deducted monthly. IMPORTANT: the cover ends when the account is closed by a full rollover — it is not transferred to Caldova. Last employer contribution received 30 Sep 2026. Exit fee: nil.

2. Harbourline Retail Super — USI HRB0007AU. Member number HR-4471902. Retail fund accumulation account. Balance about $41,800. Preservation: preserved $41,800. Tax components: tax-free $0; taxable (taxed element) $41,800. Insurance: none (cancelled at Priya's request in 2021). Fees 0.85% p.a. plus $78 p.a. Exit fee: nil.

Total to consolidate: about $138,200 ($96,400 + $41,800).

Rollover plan (in line with the SoA): Harbourline — request now through SuperStream; no insurance is lost. Southern Cross — HOLD: do not send the request until the adviser and Priya confirm in writing that she accepts losing the $520,000 Death & TPD cover, or replacement cover is in place with Caldova's group insurer. Under SIS reg 6.34A each transferring fund must complete the rollover within 3 business days of receiving all the information it needs.

On receipt, Payments invests each rollover in the Growth model and keeps 1% in the Caldova Cash Account: Harbourline $41,800 → $418 cash + $41,382 Growth; Southern Cross $96,400 → $964 cash + $95,436 Growth. The 0.10% buy spread applies to the amounts invested.
